why: THE HYBRID: best-v1's clock (kill_by_8 0.429, the goldfish leader with drain-v2) plus the five answers from prescription 8d44aef626d9 that the goldfish cannot see -- Winds of Abandon, Aetherize, Ghostly Prison, Authority of the Consuls, Suture Priest -- in place of the five goldfish-VISIBLE cards a 53-card leave-one-out sweep (10k iterations each, seed 42) found the clock needs least, chosen with judgement rather than by the number alone: Thassa +0.014, Academy Rector +0.004, Zur the Enchanter +0.005, Sheltered by Ghosts +0.006 (a targeted answer Privileged Position blanks), Mesa Enchantress +0.007 (three branches carried it and still lost 0.7 extra cards by T8). The sweep also nominated Demonic Tutor +0.013 and Phyrexian Arena +0.014 and they STAY: the goldfish cannot price a tutor that finds an answer or card advantage in a long game, and cutting on its number alone would be cutting on a blind spot. fort-v1 applied the prescription whole and read 0.296 on the same axis; this keeps the clock and asks Forge at standard-v3 whether the answers are worth five slots.
